sloka: मधुरा मधुरालापा किमाह मम भामिनी ।मद्विहीना वरारोहा हनुमन् कथयस्व मे ।। ५.६६.१५ ।।
transliteration: madhurā madhurālāpā kimāha mama bhāminī ।madvihīnā varārohā hanuman kathayasva me ।। 5.66.15 ।।

translations.english: That lovely Sita who speaks sweetly, that fairhipped beautiful one who has been separated from me, my beloved, what did she say? Please narrate. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
